verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a versioned Authy API or a formal deprecation policy, such as timelines, notice periods, or version lifecycle rules. The only related item is a one-off notice that the Authy API is closed to new customers and will be deprecated at an unspecified future date. A single deprecation announcement with no timeline is not a documented deprecation policy for versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
